title: Vardhana
desc: A man masquerades as a gangster to impress a girl he wants to marry. However, complications arise when he is entangled in a murder case.

title: Dream Girl
desc: A carefree man decides to get his act together and moves to the city to make a name for himself in order to impress the woman he loves.

title: Bandhana
desc: Harish, a doctor, falls in love with Nandini, his student. However, he slips into depression when he confesses his feelings for her and learns that she is marrying her childhood friend, Balu.

title: Nigooda Rahasya
desc: The host explores various unexplained phenomena, historical secrets and local legends across Karnataka, diving into temple mysteries and spiritual secrets to uncover the truth.

title: Haftha
desc: Expert sharpshooters plunge into the criminal depths, confronting their pasts and seeking redemption. Their intertwined journeys reveal a world of danger, transformation and unexpected alliances.
